criteria.evidence: bureau.tasks.explanation.generate (packages/bureau/src/http/management/tasks-model-explanation-operation.ts, request in run-model-explanation.ts) asks Bureau.decisions with a structured request, prices the answering catalog row (usdPricingOfRow, estimateCost) and stores {text, model, generatedAt, costUsd} on the new TaskRecord.modelExplanation (task-registry.ts recordModelExplanation, validated by isTaskModelExplanation). tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts 'AC1' reads text, model 'anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5', generatedAt and costUsd (checked against the catalog price) from the stored record; run with the scripted generate.

The request holds the stored-facts explanation (readRunFailure) and, per step, name, status, error message and guardrail verdicts, as one JSON document the fixed question calls untrusted. tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts 'AC2': a fixture whose tool arguments, a tool result and the user message each hold a marker; the serialized request the scripted model received holds none of the three, and holds charge-card, the failed status and the error text. A second test runs a tripwire guardrail and asserts its name and outcome are sent and the flagged word is not. run-model-explanation.test.ts covers the step builder and that a hostile message stays data inside the JSON.

bureau.tasks.explanation.get reads the record and calls no model. tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts 'AC3': the model is called once across generate then two reads (callCount 1), the reads equal the generated answer, a second generate makes callCount 2 and the read then returns the second text. Correction round 1: the write is fenced (recordModelExplanation takes the revision, settlement time, finish reason and message read before the model call, and returns stored or stale); a purge, or a replacing real failure, landing during the model call stores nothing and the operation answers Unprocessable run-changed (task-registry.test.ts and the operation test, each leaving modelExplanation absent). The Run page reads it when it opens (run-failure-explanation.test.ts AC3, no generate call).

With no provider the operation is UnsupportedCapability (capability generate) with a remediation that starts 'Connect a provider in Settings, under Models'. tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts 'AC4' asserts the fault and that nothing is stored; cli-runs-model-explanation.integration.test.ts and cli-runs.test.ts assert the CLI prints it and exits 1; run-failure-explanation.test.ts 'AC4' reads that remediation on the section the Run page draws (FaultErrorState), with the stored facts still drawn.

Owner decision, 2026-11-22: Explain further covers failed agent runs only (a failed instance of a workflow file has no task record to keep the text on), which is what is built. Built and tested for a failed agent run: run-failure-explanation.test.ts 'AC5' clicks 'Explain further', reads the text under 'Written by anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5' while the stored-facts summary and remediation are still rendered; run-input-output.test.ts mounts a failed task's page, clicks the action and reads the same. A failed instance of a workflow file has no task record to keep the text on, so run-input-output.test.ts asserts it offers no action and the Bureau answers run-has-no-task (tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts).

interborough runs explain <id> --model calls bureau.tasks.explanation.generate and prints the text, 'Written by <model> at <time>' and the cost (cli-runs.ts, option wired in cli-client.ts). cli-runs.test.ts asserts the exact stdout lines and the JSON output; cli-runs-model-explanation.integration.test.ts runs it against a real Bureau and handler.

The cost is kept on the explanation (modelExplanation.costUsd), and recordModelExplanation moves neither usage nor revision. tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts 'AC7' reads the task's usage before and after generate and asserts it is equal, and that the stored explanation's costUsd equals the answered one; task-registry.test.ts asserts usage and revision are unchanged after recordModelExplanation. The failing fixture agent has no priced usage, so the run's own costUsd is null on both sides; the registry test carries a priced run (costUsd 0.5) through the write.

Both operations are mcpExposable: false. tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts 'AC8' asserts that and that the handler serves them; applications/interborough/src/host/host.test.ts lists the real MCP tools/list and asserts bureau.tasks.explain is there and no bureau.tasks.explanation.* is; the MCP tool list in mcp-mount.test.ts is unchanged.

cli-runs-model-explanation.integration.test.ts: against a real Bureau, generates the explanation through the CLI, fetches the run's thread messages as the page does (GET /ag-ui/threads/<id>/messages), builds the conversation and runs chatMarkdown over it. The export holds the person's message and not the generated text; the served messages do not either. tasks-model-explanation-operation.test.ts 'AC9' reads the chat context and the task history, both of which hold the user message, and finds no generated text.
